content_html:
Hello, I'm Maneshwar. I'm building git-lrc, a Micro AI code reviewer that runs on every commit. It is free and source-available on Github. Star git-lrc to help devs discover the project. Do give it a try and share your feedback.

Let me guess.

You opened Claude Code, typed "build me a modern landing page," hit enter, and got back something that technically works but somehow looks like every other site you have ever scrolled.

Purple to blue gradients.

Inter for everything.

Little rounded icon tiles floating above every heading.

A hero section that could belong to literally any SaaS on earth.

Congratulations, you have been served a fresh bowl of AI slop.

I have been fighting this exact fight for a while now, and I want to walk you through how I actually beat it.

Not with one magic prompt, and definitely not with a 10,000 line DESIGN.md you copied from a thread.

Just three moves, a couple of tools, and a way of working that stops leaving your output to the gods of the one shot.

First, why does slop even happen?

Here is the uncomfortable truth, and it is worth sitting with for a second.

The problem with slop is not technical.

The models are not bad at writing CSS.

They are frankly great at it.

The problem is that the output is generic, and generic is a moving target.

If the models got ten times better tomorrow, they would just raise the bar on what counts as basic.

The floor moves up, the slop moves with it.

Why? Because a model trained on the public internet learns the statistical center of the public internet, and the center of the design internet in 2026 is Tailwind templates, Vercel starters, and other AI generated landing pages.

Ask for "modern" and you get the mathematical average of every landing page ever shipped. That average is the slop.

So the fix is not a better model.

The fix is you. Specifically, your taste. And that is where a lot of us cope instead of cook.

Yeah. That is the cope.

The rest of this post is about doing the opposite.

Here is the whole game on one screen before we dig in:

Step 1: Cultivate some taste (you cannot inject what you do not have)

You have heard "AI has no taste" a hundred times. Fine.

But the sneaky corollary nobody says out loud is that you need taste to hand over, and most of us have not deliberately built any. We just vibe.

So step one is boring and unglamorous and completely non negotiable: go collect stuff you like.

Become a magpie. Open Dribbble, search "web design," sort by popular, and start screenshotting the hero pages that make you feel something.

Do the same on Pinterest.

Then, and this is my personal favorite, go to Twitter slash X, where a genuinely absurd amount of the best UI work gets posted before it lands anywhere else.

Save screenshots. Save links to live sites too, since a real page tells the model way more than a flat image.

Now, you could just let those screenshots rot in a folder called inspo_FINAL_v3. Or you could do the fun version and have Claude Code spin up a tiny inspiration library web app for you.

Mine groups everything by design style, names the aesthetic in actual design vocabulary, and gives me keywords for each piece.

Click a screenshot and I can copy an image prompt (for generating a matching hero background later) or copy a full brief (for generating the whole page).

It turns a pile of pretty pictures into a reusable palette of your taste.

The point of this step is not to copy anyone.

It is to give your future self a base to point at, so you are never starting from a blank prompt and an average result.

You are starting from a direction you already know you like.

Step 2: Arm Claude Code with tools it does not ship with

Out of the box, Claude Code is a strong developer with the visual judgment of a coin flip.

So we hand it better eyes and better hands. Three categories are enough.

A real design skill

The default Anthropic frontend-design skill was a fine start, but at this point it kind of produces the slop it was meant to prevent.

The one I reach for now is Impeccable, an open source Claude Code skill by Paul Bakaus.

Instead of vaguely begging the model to "not look AI generated" (which never works), it does something clever: it names the specific slop patterns and tells the model to avoid them.

It ships as one skill with a stack of commands you invoke like slash commands. A few that I use constantly:

  • /critique for an honest UX review of hierarchy and clarity
  • /bolder to push a safe, boring design toward actual impact
  • /quieter to pull an over caffeinated design back down
  • /polish for a final alignment and spacing pass before shipping

Under the hood it hunts slop across seven areas: typography, color, spatial design, responsiveness, interaction, motion, and UX writing.

There is even a Chrome extension that highlights slop patterns on a live site, which is a little bit rude and extremely useful.

The before and after examples in the docs sell it better than I can.

If Impeccable is not your flavor, there are other "taste" style skills in the same spirit floating around GitHub, and they work on the same principle.

An image and video MCP

Claude Code cannot draw. It cannot generate that moody cinematic mountain range you want behind your hero text.

So give it the ability with the Higgsfield MCP, which basically hands your agent a backstage pass to 30 plus image and video models through a single connection.

You describe the hero image, it generates it, drops it into the section, done. No tab hopping to five other tools.

A component registry

For the smaller stuff, buttons, cards, pricing sections, pagination (when was the last time you thought hard about pagination?), I browse 21st.dev.

It is an open registry where each component ships with a "copy prompt" button.

Paste that into Claude Code and it rebuilds the component inside your codebase, wired to your stack.

Think of it as step one's taste hunting, but zoomed all the way in to the component level.

One warning before you go tool shopping

Here is the trap, and I have fallen in it more than once.

It is very easy to convince yourself you are one skill away from all your design problems being solved. You are not.

You will find flashy skills that build gorgeous sites.

The catch is they tend to be narrow and extremely prescriptive, so they hand you exactly one kind of output every time.

That is not taste, that is a template with extra steps.

I like Impeccable and Higgsfield precisely because they are flexible.

The downside of flexible is that they will not magically produce greatness. That still depends on your prompting and your taste. Which is the point.

Step 3: Build in loops, not in one shots

This is the mindset shift that changed everything for me, so read it twice: stop trying to one shot.

The one shot is a lottery ticket.

You type "make it premium," hit enter, and pray.

Sometimes you win. Usually you get slop with a slightly nicer font.

Instead, cast a very wide net up front, then narrow down.

Here is the actual sequence I run:

Let me make that concrete.

Say I am building a landing page for a made up AI analytics startup called Kestrel, and the goal is to get people to book a demo.

First, five versions in five styles, all at once. Not one, five.

If you built that inspiration library from step one, you can just tell Claude Code to look at it, pull five aesthetic families, and build a page in each.

Seeing them side by side on one screen makes it obvious which direction has legs, in a way that squinting at a terminal one attempt at a time never does.

Say I land on a "vast quiet" minimalist look with a big cinematic image behind the hero.

Then, three variations of that one direction.

Same aesthetic, different body layouts.

Maybe one is super vertical and minimal, one is a "ledger" style with an index that scrolls alongside you, one frames each section with edges.

I pick the ledger, because that scrolling index is genuinely cool.

Then I nail the hero image before fussing with anything else.

I fire up the Higgsfield MCP, ask for four 2K options that fit the quiet aesthetic, and look at them in the actual hero slot.

Too black and white? Ask for variations with a splash of color.

That gentle golden "alpenglow" one? Sold.

Then transitions and weight.

I ask for the hero to fade into the body instead of hard cutting, and for elements to load in with a bit of heft so the whole thing feels premium rather than snappy and cheap.

Notice what is happening.

At every stage I am seeing options and choosing, not blindly trusting a single generation. That is the whole trick.

The four things worth putting in your prompt

You do not need a giant design doc.

When those get too specific, they just produce the same thing every time, which is the slop problem wearing a fancier coat.

I pass four things, loosely:

  1. Aesthetic. The general family of design you are going for.
  2. Reference image. This is where your taste library earns its keep. Drop a screenshot, or better, an actual URL of a site you like. You are matching a feeling, not copying content.
  3. Intent. What is this and why does it exist? SaaS product? Event page? Who is the audience and what do you want them to do, read, click, or fill out?
  4. Guardrails. The always and the never. This is your anti slop clause. "Never use purple gradients. Never use Inter. No 3D SaaS blobs."

The secret weapon: a live tweak bar

Even after all that, the page felt almost right but a touch too minimal.

Instead of guessing with more "make it pop" prompts, I asked Claude Code to add a live tweak bar to the dev server, the kind of panel you see inside Claude Design.

Font family, font size, accent color, motion, reveal distance, anything where a design decision lives.

Now I iterate by eye.

I flip through fonts in real time instead of asking for ten rebuilt pages and comparing them like a lunatic.

Being able to see differences instantly is the thing that finally gets you to something you actually like. And do not forget: references are not just for the hero.

Feed the model URLs and screenshots for how you want the body laid out too, since Claude Code can look at a live page and apply its structure.

Wrapping up

None of this is a rulebook. Do not follow it to the letter, because the second something becomes a rigid formula, it starts producing its own flavor of slop.

The point is a flexible workflow you can bend to any project:

Cultivate taste so you have something to hand over.

Arm your agent with a design skill, an image MCP, and a component registry.

Then build in loops, wide net first, tweak by eye last, so you are never at the mercy of a single roll of the dice.

The moat was never the toolbox.

It was always your taste.

Go build something that looks like you, and leave the purple gradients where they belong.

If you try this, I would love to see what you ship. Drop a link in the comments and let us compare notes.

AI agents write code fast. They also silently remove logic, change behavior, and introduce bugs — without telling you. You often find out in production.

git-lrc fixes this. It hooks into git commit and reviews every diff before it lands. 60-second setup. Completely free.

Any feedback or contributors are welcome! It's online, source-available, and ready for anyone to use.

But AI agents silently break things: they remove logic, relax constraints, introduce expensive cloud calls, leak credentials, and change behavior -- without telling you. You often find out in production.

git-lrc is your braking system. It hooks into git commit and runs an AI review on every diff before it lands. 60-second setup. Completely free.

blocks.html_en: But the sneaky corollary nobody says out loud is that you need taste to hand over, and most of us have not deliberately built any. We just vibe.

sentences.en: But the sneaky corollary nobody says out loud is that you need taste to hand over, and most of us have not deliberately built any.

sentences.en: We just vibe.

blocks.html_en: So step one is boring and unglamorous and completely non negotiable: go collect stuff you like.

sentences.en: So step one is boring and unglamorous and completely non negotiable: go collect stuff you like.
sentences.zh: 所以第一步是无聊、乏味且完全没有商量余地的：去收集你喜欢的东西。

blocks.html_en: Become a magpie. Open Dribbble, search "web design," sort by popular, and start screenshotting the hero pages that make you feel something.

sentences.en: Become a magpie.
sentences.zh: 变成喜鹊。

sentences.en: Open Dribbble, search "web design," sort by popular, and start screenshotting the hero pages that make you feel something.

blocks.html_en: Do the same on Pinterest.

sentences.en: Do the same on Pinterest.
sentences.zh: 在 Pinterest 上做同样的事情。

blocks.html_en: Then, and this is my personal favorite, go to Twitter slash X, where a genuinely absurd amount of the best UI work gets posted before it lands anywhere else.

sentences.en: Then, and this is my personal favorite, go to Twitter slash X, where a genuinely absurd amount of the best UI work gets posted before it lands anywhere else.
sentences.zh: 然后，这是我个人最喜欢的，去 Twitterlash X，那里有大量真正荒谬的最佳 UI 作品在发布到其他地方之前就被发布了。

blocks.html_en: Save screenshots. Save links to live sites too, since a real page tells the model way more than a flat image.

blocks.html_en: Now, you could just let those screenshots rot in a folder called inspo_FINAL_v3. Or you could do the fun version and have Claude Code spin up a tiny inspiration library web app for you.

sentences.en: Now, you could just let those screenshots rot in a folder called inspo_FINAL_v3.
sentences.zh: 现在，您可以让这些屏幕截图在名为 inspo_FINAL_v3 的文件夹中腐烂。

sentences.zh: 或者，您可以制作有趣的版本，让 Claude Code 为您启动一个小型灵感库 Web 应用程序。

blocks.html_en: Mine groups everything by design style, names the aesthetic in actual design vocabulary, and gives me keywords for each piece.

sentences.en: Mine groups everything by design style, names the aesthetic in actual design vocabulary, and gives me keywords for each piece.
sentences.zh: 我的作品按设计风格对所有内容进行分组，在实际设计词汇中命名美学，并为每件作品提供关键词。

blocks.html_en: Click a screenshot and I can copy an image prompt (for generating a matching hero background later) or copy a full brief (for generating the whole page).

sentences.en: Click a screenshot and I can copy an image prompt (for generating a matching hero background later) or copy a full brief (for generating the whole page).
sentences.zh: 单击屏幕截图，我可以复制图像提示（用于稍后生成匹配的英雄背景）或复制完整的简介（用于生成整个页面）。

blocks.html_en: It turns a pile of pretty pictures into a reusable palette of your taste.

sentences.en: It turns a pile of pretty pictures into a reusable palette of your taste.
sentences.zh: 它将一堆漂亮的图片变成适合您口味的可重复使用的调色板。

blocks.html_en: The point of this step is not to copy anyone.

sentences.en: The point of this step is not to copy anyone.
sentences.zh: 这一步的重点不是复制任何人。

blocks.html_en: It is to give your future self a base to point at, so you are never starting from a blank prompt and an average result.

sentences.en: It is to give your future self a base to point at, so you are never starting from a blank prompt and an average result.
sentences.zh: 它是为了给未来的自己一个指向的基础，这样你就永远不会从空白的提示和平均的结果开始。

blocks.html_en: You are starting from a direction you already know you like.

sentences.en: You are starting from a direction you already know you like.
sentences.zh: 你正从一个你已经知道你喜欢的方向开始。

blocks.html_en: Step 2: Arm Claude Code with tools it does not ship with

sentences.en: Step 2: Arm Claude Code with tools it does not ship with
sentences.zh: 第 2 步：使用 Claude Code 未附带的工具来启动它

sentences.en: Out of the box, Claude Code is a strong developer with the visual judgment of a coin flip.
sentences.zh: Claude Code 是一位开箱即用的强大开发人员，具有抛硬币的视觉判断能力。

blocks.html_en: So we hand it better eyes and better hands. Three categories are enough.

sentences.en: So we hand it better eyes and better hands.
sentences.zh: 所以我们赋予它更好的眼睛和更好的双手。

sentences.en: Three categories are enough.
sentences.zh: 三个类别就足够了。

blocks.html_en: A real design skill

sentences.en: A real design skill
sentences.zh: 真正的设计技巧

blocks.html_en: The default Anthropic frontend-design skill was a fine start, but at this point it kind of produces the slop it was meant to prevent.

sentences.en: The default Anthropic frontend-design skill was a fine start, but at this point it kind of produces the slop it was meant to prevent.
sentences.zh: 默认的 Anthropic 前端设计技能是一个良好的开端，但此时它有点产生了本应防止的问题。

blocks.html_en: The one I reach for now is Impeccable, an open source Claude Code skill by Paul Bakaus.

sentences.en: The one I reach for now is Impeccable, an open source Claude Code skill by Paul Bakaus.
sentences.zh: 我现在接触的是 Impeccable，这是 Paul Bakaus 的一项开源 Claude Code 技能。

blocks.html_en: Instead of vaguely begging the model to "not look AI generated" (which never works), it does something clever: it names the specific slop patterns and tells the model to avoid them.

sentences.en: Instead of vaguely begging the model to "not look AI generated" (which never works), it does something clever: it names the specific slop patterns and tells the model to avoid them.
sentences.zh: 它没有含糊地请求模型“不要看起来是人工智能生成的”（这永远不会起作用），而是做了一些聪明的事情：它命名了特定的倾斜模式并告诉模型避免它们。

blocks.html_en: It ships as one skill with a stack of commands you invoke like slash commands. A few that I use constantly:

sentences.en: It ships as one skill with a stack of commands you invoke like slash commands.
sentences.zh: 它作为一项技能与您调用的一堆命令（如斜线命令）一起提供。

sentences.en: A few that I use constantly:
sentences.zh: 我经常使用的一些：

blocks.html_en: • /critique for an honest UX review of hierarchy and clarity

sentences.en: /critique for an honest UX review of hierarchy and clarity
sentences.zh: /critique 对层次结构和清晰度进行诚实的用户体验审查

blocks.html_en: • /bolder to push a safe, boring design toward actual impact

sentences.en: /bolder to push a safe, boring design toward actual impact
sentences.zh: /bolder 将安全、无聊的设计推向实际影响

blocks.html_en: • /quieter to pull an over caffeinated design back down

sentences.en: /quieter to pull an over caffeinated design back down
sentences.zh: /quieter 将过度咖啡因的设计拉回来

blocks.html_en: • /polish for a final alignment and spacing pass before shipping

sentences.en: /polish for a final alignment and spacing pass before shipping
sentences.zh: /polish 在发货前进行最终的对齐和间距处理

blocks.html_en: Under the hood it hunts slop across seven areas: typography, color, spatial design, responsiveness, interaction, motion, and UX writing.

sentences.en: Under the hood it hunts slop across seven areas: typography, color, spatial design, responsiveness, interaction, motion, and UX writing.
sentences.zh: 它在底层寻找七个领域的缺陷：排版、颜色、空间设计、响应能力、交互、动作和用户体验写作。

blocks.html_en: There is even a Chrome extension that highlights slop patterns on a live site, which is a little bit rude and extremely useful.

sentences.en: There is even a Chrome extension that highlights slop patterns on a live site, which is a little bit rude and extremely useful.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有一个 Chrome 扩展程序可以在实时站点上突出显示倾斜模式，这有点粗鲁但非常有用。

blocks.html_en: The before and after examples in the docs sell it better than I can.

sentences.en: The before and after examples in the docs sell it better than I can.
sentences.zh: 文档中的前后示例比我卖得更好。

blocks.html_en: If Impeccable is not your flavor, there are other "taste" style skills in the same spirit floating around GitHub, and they work on the same principle.

sentences.en: If Impeccable is not your flavor, there are other "taste" style skills in the same spirit floating around GitHub, and they work on the same principle.
sentences.zh: 如果《Impeccable》不符合您的口味，那么 GitHub 上还有其他本着同样精神的“品味”风格技能，它们的工作原理相同。

blocks.html_en: An image and video MCP

sentences.en: An image and video MCP
sentences.zh: 图像和视频 MCP

sentences.en: Claude Code cannot draw.
sentences.zh: 克劳德·科德不会画画。

sentences.zh: 它无法在英雄文本后面生成您想要的喜怒无常的电影山脉。

blocks.html_en: So give it the ability with the Higgsfield MCP, which basically hands your agent a backstage pass to 30 plus image and video models through a single connection.

sentences.en: So give it the ability with the Higgsfield MCP, which basically hands your agent a backstage pass to 30 plus image and video models through a single connection.
sentences.zh: 因此，请赋予它 Higgsfield MCP 的能力，它基本上可以通过单个连接为您的代理提供 30 多个图像和视频模型的后台通行证。

blocks.html_en: You describe the hero image, it generates it, drops it into the section, done. No tab hopping to five other tools.

sentences.en: You describe the hero image, it generates it, drops it into the section, done.
sentences.zh: 您描述英雄图像，它生成它，将其放入该部分，完成。

sentences.en: No tab hopping to five other tools.
sentences.zh: 无需跳到其他五个工具。

blocks.html_en: A component registry

sentences.en: A component registry
sentences.zh: 组件注册表

blocks.html_en: For the smaller stuff, buttons, cards, pricing sections, pagination (when was the last time you thought hard about pagination?), I browse 21st.dev.

sentences.en: For the smaller stuff, buttons, cards, pricing sections, pagination (when was the last time you thought hard about pagination?), I browse 21st.dev.
sentences.zh: 对于较小的东西，按钮，卡片，定价部分，分页（你最后一次仔细考虑分页是什么时候？），我浏览 21st.dev。

blocks.html_en: It is an open registry where each component ships with a "copy prompt" button.

sentences.en: It is an open registry where each component ships with a "copy prompt" button.
sentences.zh: 它是一个开放的注册表，其中每个组件都附带一个“复制提示”按钮。

blocks.html_en: Paste that into Claude Code and it rebuilds the component inside your codebase, wired to your stack.

sentences.en: Paste that into Claude Code and it rebuilds the component inside your codebase, wired to your stack.
sentences.zh: 将其粘贴到 Claude Code 中，它会在您的代码库中重建组件，并将其连接到您的堆栈。

blocks.html_en: Think of it as step one's taste hunting, but zoomed all the way in to the component level.

sentences.en: Think of it as step one's taste hunting, but zoomed all the way in to the component level.
sentences.zh: 将其视为一步一步的品味搜寻，但一直放大到组件级别。

blocks.html_en: One warning before you go tool shopping

sentences.en: One warning before you go tool shopping
sentences.zh: 购买工具之前的一个警告

blocks.html_en: Here is the trap, and I have fallen in it more than once.

sentences.en: Here is the trap, and I have fallen in it more than once.
sentences.zh: 这就是陷阱，我已经不止一次陷入其中了。

blocks.html_en: It is very easy to convince yourself you are one skill away from all your design problems being solved. You are not.

sentences.en: It is very easy to convince yourself you are one skill away from all your design problems being solved.
sentences.zh: 你很容易说服自己，只要掌握一项技能，就能解决所有设计问题。

sentences.en: You are not.
sentences.zh: 你不是。

blocks.html_en: You will find flashy skills that build gorgeous sites.

sentences.en: You will find flashy skills that build gorgeous sites.
sentences.zh: 您会发现构建华丽网站的华丽技能。

blocks.html_en: The catch is they tend to be narrow and extremely prescriptive, so they hand you exactly one kind of output every time.

sentences.en: The catch is they tend to be narrow and extremely prescriptive, so they hand you exactly one kind of output every time.
sentences.zh: 问题是它们往往很狭窄并且非常规范，因此它们每次都会为您提供一种输出。

blocks.html_en: That is not taste, that is a template with extra steps.

sentences.en: That is not taste, that is a template with extra steps.
sentences.zh: 那不是品味，那是带有额外步骤的模板。

blocks.html_en: I like Impeccable and Higgsfield precisely because they are flexible.

sentences.en: I like Impeccable and Higgsfield precisely because they are flexible.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢Impeccable 和Higgsfield 正是因为它们很灵活。

blocks.html_en: The downside of flexible is that they will not magically produce greatness. That still depends on your prompting and your taste. Which is the point.

sentences.en: The downside of flexible is that they will not magically produce greatness.
sentences.zh: 灵活的缺点是它们不会神奇地产生伟大的成果。

sentences.en: That still depends on your prompting and your taste.
sentences.zh: 这仍然取决于你的提示和你的品味。

sentences.en: Which is the point.
sentences.zh: 这就是重点。

blocks.html_en: Step 3: Build in loops, not in one shots

sentences.en: Step 3: Build in loops, not in one shots
sentences.zh: 第 3 步：循环构建，而不是一次性构建

blocks.html_en: This is the mindset shift that changed everything for me, so read it twice: stop trying to one shot.

sentences.en: This is the mindset shift that changed everything for me, so read it twice: stop trying to one shot.
sentences.zh: 这种心态的转变改变了我的一切，所以请读两遍：停止尝试一次。

blocks.html_en: The one shot is a lottery ticket.

sentences.en: The one shot is a lottery ticket.
sentences.zh: 一枪就是一张彩票。

blocks.html_en: You type "make it premium," hit enter, and pray.

sentences.en: You type "make it premium," hit enter, and pray.
sentences.zh: 你输入“make it premium”，按回车键，然后祈祷。

sentences.zh: 相反，在前面撒下一张非常宽的网，然后缩小范围。

blocks.html_en: Here is the actual sequence I run:

sentences.en: Here is the actual sequence I run:
sentences.zh: 这是我运行的实际序列：

blocks.html_en: Let me make that concrete.

sentences.en: Let me make that concrete.
sentences.zh: 让我具体说一下。

blocks.html_en: Say I am building a landing page for a made up AI analytics startup called Kestrel, and the goal is to get people to book a demo.

sentences.en: Say I am building a landing page for a made up AI analytics startup called Kestrel, and the goal is to get people to book a demo.
sentences.zh: 假设我正在为一家名为 Kestrel 的人工智能分析初创公司构建一个登陆页面，目标是让人们预订演示。

blocks.html_en: First, five versions in five styles, all at once. Not one, five.

sentences.en: First, five versions in five styles, all at once.
sentences.zh: 首先，同时推出五个版本、五种风格。

sentences.en: Not one, five.
sentences.zh: 不是一个，是五个。

blocks.html_en: If you built that inspiration library from step one, you can just tell Claude Code to look at it, pull five aesthetic families, and build a page in each.

sentences.en: If you built that inspiration library from step one, you can just tell Claude Code to look at it, pull five aesthetic families, and build a page in each.
sentences.zh: 如果您从第一步就构建了该灵感库，则只需告诉 Claude Code 查看它，拉出五个美学系列，并在每个美学系列中构建一个页面即可。

blocks.html_en: Seeing them side by side on one screen makes it obvious which direction has legs, in a way that squinting at a terminal one attempt at a time never does.

sentences.en: Seeing them side by side on one screen makes it obvious which direction has legs, in a way that squinting at a terminal one attempt at a time never does.
sentences.zh: 在一个屏幕上并排看到它们可以很明显地看出哪个方向有腿，在某种程度上，一次一次地眯着眼睛看终端是永远不会的。

blocks.html_en: Say I land on a "vast quiet" minimalist look with a big cinematic image behind the hero.

sentences.en: Say I land on a "vast quiet" minimalist look with a big cinematic image behind the hero.
sentences.zh: 假设我选择了“巨大安静”的极简主义外观，英雄背后有一个巨大的电影图像。

blocks.html_en: Then, three variations of that one direction.

sentences.en: Then, three variations of that one direction.
sentences.zh: 然后，该一个方向的三种变化。

blocks.html_en: Same aesthetic, different body layouts.

sentences.en: Same aesthetic, different body layouts.
sentences.zh: 相同的审美，不同的车身布局。

sentences.en: Maybe one is super vertical and minimal, one is a "ledger" style with an index that scrolls alongside you, one frames each section with edges.
sentences.zh: 也许一种是超级垂直和最小的，一种是“分类帐”样式，索引可以在您旁边滚动，每个部分都有边缘。

blocks.html_en: I pick the ledger, because that scrolling index is genuinely cool.

sentences.en: I pick the ledger, because that scrolling index is genuinely cool.
sentences.zh: 我选择分类账，因为滚动索引真的很酷。

sentences.en: Then I nail the hero image before fussing with anything else.
sentences.zh: 然后我先确定英雄形象，然后再忙于其他事情。

blocks.html_en: I fire up the Higgsfield MCP, ask for four 2K options that fit the quiet aesthetic, and look at them in the actual hero slot.

sentences.en: I fire up the Higgsfield MCP, ask for four 2K options that fit the quiet aesthetic, and look at them in the actual hero slot.
sentences.zh: 我启动了 Higgsfield MCP，要求提供四个适合安静审美的 2K 选项，然后在实际的英雄插槽中查看它们。

blocks.html_en: Too black and white? Ask for variations with a splash of color.

sentences.en: Too black and white?
sentences.zh: 太黑太白？

sentences.en: Ask for variations with a splash of color.
sentences.zh: 要求有一些色彩的变化。

blocks.html_en: That gentle golden "alpenglow" one? Sold.

sentences.en: That gentle golden "alpenglow" one?
sentences.zh: 那个温柔的金色“朝霞”？

blocks.html_en: Then transitions and weight.

sentences.en: Then transitions and weight.

blocks.html_en: I ask for the hero to fade into the body instead of hard cutting, and for elements to load in with a bit of heft so the whole thing feels premium rather than snappy and cheap.

blocks.html_en: Notice what is happening.

sentences.zh: 注意发生了什么。

sentences.zh: 值得在提示中添加的四件事

sentences.en: You do not need a giant design doc.
sentences.zh: 您不需要庞大的设计文档。

content_html_zh:
你好，我是马内什瓦尔。 我正在构建 git-lrc，一个在每次提交时运行的 Micro AI 代码审查器。 它是免费的，并且可以在 Github 上获取源代码。 星标 git-lrc 以帮助开发人员发现该项目。 请尝试一下并分享您的反馈。

让我猜一下。

你打开 Claude Code，输入“为我构建一个现代化的登陆页面”，然后按回车键，然后返回了一些技术上可行的内容，但不知怎的，它看起来就像你曾经滚动过的所有其他网站一样。

紫色到蓝色的渐变。

国际米兰为一切。

每个标题上方漂浮的小圆形图标图块。

这是一个可以属于地球上任何 SaaS 的英雄部分。

恭喜，您已经享用了一碗新鲜的 AI 污水。

我已经为这场斗争奋斗了一段时间了，我想向您介绍我是如何真正战胜它的。

不是一个神奇的提示符，也绝对不是你从线程复制的 10,000 行 DESIGN.md。

只需三个动作、几个工具和一种工作方式，即可不再将您的输出交给一击之神。

首先，为什么会发生倾斜？

这是一个令人不安的事实，值得静待片刻。

倾斜问题不是技术性的。

模型编写 CSS 的能力还不错。

坦率地说，他们很擅长。

问题在于输出是通用的，而通用是一个移动目标。

如果模型明天变得好十倍，他们只会提高基本标准。

地板向上移动，斜坡也随之移动。

为什么？ 因为在公共互联网上训练的模型会学习公共互联网的统计中心，而2026年设计互联网的中心是Tailwind模板、Vercel启动器和其他AI生成的登陆页面。

询问“现代”，您会得到曾经发布的每个着陆页的数学平均值。 该平均值就是斜率。

所以修复并不是一个更好的模型。

解决办法就是你。 具体来说，你的口味。 这就是我们很多人应付而不是做饭的地方。

是的。 这就是应付。

这篇文章的其余部分是关于做相反的事情。

在我们深入研究之前，这是一个屏幕上的整个游戏：

第一步：培养一些品味（你没有的东西不能注入）

“人工智能没有品味”你已经听过一百遍了。 美好的。

但没有人大声说出来的一个偷偷摸摸的推论是，你需要交出品味，而我们大多数人并没有刻意建造任何品味。 我们只是氛围。

所以第一步是无聊、乏味且完全没有商量余地的：去收集你喜欢的东西。

变成喜鹊。 打开 Dribbble，搜索“网页设计”，按流行排序，然后开始截屏那些让你有感觉的英雄页面。

在 Pinterest 上做同样的事情。

然后，这是我个人最喜欢的，去 Twitterlash X，那里有大量真正荒谬的最佳 UI 作品在发布到其他地方之前就被发布了。

保存截图。 还要保存指向实时站点的链接，因为真实页面比平面图像更能告诉模型。

现在，您可以让这些屏幕截图在名为 inspo_FINAL_v3 的文件夹中腐烂。 或者，您可以制作有趣的版本，让 Claude Code 为您启动一个小型灵感库 Web 应用程序。

我的作品按设计风格对所有内容进行分组，在实际设计词汇中命名美学，并为每件作品提供关键词。

单击屏幕截图，我可以复制图像提示（用于稍后生成匹配的英雄背景）或复制完整的简介（用于生成整个页面）。

它将一堆漂亮的图片变成适合您口味的可重复使用的调色板。

这一步的重点不是复制任何人。

它是为了给未来的自己一个指向的基础，这样你就永远不会从空白的提示和平均的结果开始。

你正从一个你已经知道你喜欢的方向开始。

第 2 步：使用 Claude Code 未附带的工具来启动它

Claude Code 是一位开箱即用的强大开发人员，具有抛硬币的视觉判断能力。

所以我们赋予它更好的眼睛和更好的双手。 三个类别就足够了。

真正的设计技巧

默认的 Anthropic 前端设计技能是一个良好的开端，但此时它有点产生了本应防止的问题。

我现在接触的是 Impeccable，这是 Paul Bakaus 的一项开源 Claude Code 技能。

它没有含糊地请求模型“不要看起来是人工智能生成的”（这永远不会起作用），而是做了一些聪明的事情：它命名了特定的倾斜模式并告诉模型避免它们。

它作为一项技能与您调用的一堆命令（如斜线命令）一起提供。 我经常使用的一些：

  • /critique 对层次结构和清晰度进行诚实的用户体验审查
  • /bolder 将安全、无聊的设计推向实际影响
  • /quieter 将过度咖啡因的设计拉回来
  • /polish 在发货前进行最终的对齐和间距处理

它在底层寻找七个领域的缺陷：排版、颜色、空间设计、响应能力、交互、动作和用户体验写作。

甚至还有一个 Chrome 扩展程序可以在实时站点上突出显示倾斜模式，这有点粗鲁但非常有用。

文档中的前后示例比我卖得更好。

如果《Impeccable》不符合您的口味，那么 GitHub 上还有其他本着同样精神的“品味”风格技能，它们的工作原理相同。

图像和视频 MCP

克劳德·科德不会画画。 它无法在英雄文本后面生成您想要的喜怒无常的电影山脉。

因此，请赋予它 Higgsfield MCP 的能力，它基本上可以通过单个连接为您的代理提供 30 多个图像和视频模型的后台通行证。

您描述英雄图像，它生成它，将其放入该部分，完成。 无需跳到其他五个工具。

组件注册表

对于较小的东西，按钮，卡片，定价部分，分页（你最后一次仔细考虑分页是什么时候？），我浏览 21st.dev。

它是一个开放的注册表，其中每个组件都附带一个“复制提示”按钮。

将其粘贴到 Claude Code 中，它会在您的代码库中重建组件，并将其连接到您的堆栈。

将其视为一步一步的品味搜寻，但一直放大到组件级别。

购买工具之前的一个警告

这就是陷阱，我已经不止一次陷入其中了。

你很容易说服自己，只要掌握一项技能，就能解决所有设计问题。 你不是。

您会发现构建华丽网站的华丽技能。

问题是它们往往很狭窄并且非常规范，因此它们每次都会为您提供一种输出。

那不是品味，那是带有额外步骤的模板。

我喜欢Impeccable 和Higgsfield 正是因为它们很灵活。

灵活的缺点是它们不会神奇地产生伟大的成果。 这仍然取决于你的提示和你的品味。 这就是重点。

第 3 步：循环构建，而不是一次性构建

这种心态的转变改变了我的一切，所以请读两遍：停止尝试一次。

一枪就是一张彩票。

你输入“make it premium”，按回车键，然后祈祷。

有时你会赢。 通常，使用稍微好一点的字体会显得很糟糕。

相反，在前面撒下一张非常宽的网，然后缩小范围。

这是我运行的实际序列：

让我具体说一下。

假设我正在为一家名为 Kestrel 的人工智能分析初创公司构建一个登陆页面，目标是让人们预订演示。

首先，同时推出五个版本、五种风格。 不是一个，是五个。

如果您从第一步就构建了该灵感库，则只需告诉 Claude Code 查看它，拉出五个美学系列，并在每个美学系列中构建一个页面即可。

在一个屏幕上并排看到它们可以很明显地看出哪个方向有腿，在某种程度上，一次一次地眯着眼睛看终端是永远不会的。

假设我选择了“巨大安静”的极简主义外观，英雄背后有一个巨大的电影图像。

然后，该一个方向的三种变化。

相同的审美，不同的车身布局。

也许一种是超级垂直和最小的，一种是“分类帐”样式，索引可以在您旁边滚动，每个部分都有边缘。

我选择分类账，因为滚动索引真的很酷。

然后我先确定英雄形象，然后再忙于其他事情。

我启动了 Higgsfield MCP，要求提供四个适合安静审美的 2K 选项，然后在实际的英雄插槽中查看它们。

太黑太白？ 要求有一些色彩的变化。

那个温柔的金色“朝霞”？ 卖。

然后是过渡和重量。

我要求英雄逐渐融入身体而不是硬剪，并要求元素加载一点分量，这样整个事情就感觉高级，而不是活泼和廉价。

注意发生了什么。

在每个阶段我都会看到选择和选择，而不是盲目地相信某一代人。 这就是整个技巧。

值得在提示中添加的四件事

您不需要庞大的设计文档。

当这些变得太具体时，他们每次都会产生相同的东西，这就是穿着更漂亮的外套的问题。

我松散地传递了四件事：

  1. 审美的。 您想要的一般设计系列。
  2. 参考图片。 这是您的品味库得以保留的地方。 放一张屏幕截图，或者更好的是，放一个您喜欢的网站的实际 URL。 你是在匹配一种感觉，而不是复制内容。
  3. 意图。 这是什么以及为什么存在？ SaaS 产品？ 活动页面？ 谁是受众？您希望他们做什么、阅读、点击或填写？
  4. 护栏。 总是和从不。 这是您的反溢出条款。 “永远不要使用紫色渐变。 永远不要使用国际米兰。 不是 3D SaaS blob。”

秘密武器：实时调整栏

即使在这一切之后，页面感觉几乎正确，但有点太少了。

我没有用更多的“使其流行”提示来猜测，而是要求 Claude Code 在开发服务器上添加一个实时调整栏，就像您在 Claude Design 中看到的那种面板。

字体系列、字体大小、强调色、动作、显示距离，以及设计决策所涉及的任何内容。
